clue.text: Another name for a Jurassic series

parts.note: the Lias is the lowest series of rocks in the Jurassic system of geology

explanation.surface: A geologist looks for an alternative title for a set of Jurassic rocks.
explanation.definitionFit: An alias is an assumed name used instead of, or beside, a person's real one.

clue.text: Everyone has a strong desire to be in harmony

parts.note: all means everyone
greed is an intense desire for more

explanation.surface: Each person shares a burning ambition to get along.
explanation.definitionFit: When opinions match completely there is unanimous accord.

clue.text: A fellow in spasmodic pain crumpled up

indicators.note: the fellow is placed within the jumbled pain
spasmodic means fitful and irregular, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man, a fellow

explanation.surface: A man doubled over by fitful stabbing pain collapses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spasmodic' rearranges PAIN to INAP, and 'in' puts A HE inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying collapsed in a heap means slumped in an untidy pile.

clue.text: Spare a former Governor General of Australia

definitions.text: a former Governor General of Australia
definitions.meaning: Field Marshal Sir William ... was Governor-General of Australia in the 1950s

explanation.definitionFit: Slim means spare or thin, and Sir William Slim served as Australia's Governor-General.

clue.text: Spanish Johnny gets taken in by Mary-the dope!

indicators.note: Johnny is taken in, so his Spanish form sits inside the name for Mary

parts.note: Maria is the Spanish and Latin form of the name Mary
Juan is the Spanish form of John, Johnny

explanation.surface: A Spanish lad called Johnny is duped by a girl called Mary, who calls him a dope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the dope!' reads as an insult at Johnny, but dope is slang for cannabis.
explanation.definitionFit: Dope is slang for cannabis, the drug also called pot or weed.

clue.text: Turn with hesitation at score providing fair amusement

parts.note: to roll is to turn over and over
er is the sound of hesitating

indicators.note: providing here means producing, so the letters provide a new word

explanation.surface: A dithering performer turns at the score of a song for a fairground act.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the steep track ride that is a staple attraction at a funfair.

clue.text: Standard way to lift a car

definitions.meaning: a flag, as the Union ... is the British flag
a device for raising a vehicle to change a wheel

explanation.definitionFit: A jack is a small ship's flag, a standard, and also the lifting tool for raising a vehicle.

clue.text: Concerns African trade exhibitions

parts.note: Af is an abbreviation for African
trade fairs are exhibitions of goods

explanation.surface: Worries about commerce shows held in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Affairs are matters, business or concerns that occupy someone.

clue.text: Expert clad in an item of protective clothing

indicators.note: clad in means dressed in, so the expert is wrapped inside the article

parts.note: taken as written
a pro, short for professional, is an expert

explanation.surface: A professional wears an outfit that protects him.
explanation.definitionFit: An apron is worn over the front to protect clothes from mess.

clue.text: Letting local county educationalists inform the police

parts.note: LEA stands for Local Education Authority, the body that ran a British county's schools
to sing is slang for informing on accomplices to the police

explanation.surface: A council's schools officials are renting property out and reporting to the police.
explanation.walkthrough: An LEA (Local Education Authority) was the British council body running state schools.
explanation.definitionFit: Leasing property is letting it out to a tenant for rent.

clue.text: Imposing portico made by a demonstrative prima donna

definitions.meaning: a magnificent doorway or porch to a building

definitions.text: made by a demonstrative prima donna
definitions.meaning: a showy diva sweeping dramatically on stage

explanation.definitionFit: A grand entrance is a fine main doorway and also a dramatic arrival a diva makes.

clue.text: A match for old Harry

definitions.meaning: an early friction match struck to make fire
Old Harry is a traditional nickname for the Devil, Satan

explanation.definitionFit: Lucifer names both an old-fashioned friction match and Satan, the Devil, nicknamed Old Harry.

clue.text: Fat man in an exemplary turn-round

indicators.note: the word for man is placed inside the reversed abbreviation
a turn-round sends the letters of the abbreviation backwards

parts.note: e.g. (for example) is the abbreviation suggested by exemplary
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A stout fellow makes a model about-turn on parade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn-round' reverses EG to GE, and 'in' puts HE inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghee is clarified butter, a cooking fat used in Indian cuisine.

clue.text: Paid a pound for a hammer

parts.note: gave can mean paid, as in gave a price for something
L, from Latin libra, is the abbreviation for a pound

explanation.surface: Someone spent a pound buying a hammer.
explanation.definitionFit: A gavel is the small mallet an auctioneer or judge bangs for order.

clue.text: The demeanour of one in the ranks

indicators.note: one is put inside the word for the ranks

parts.note: the men are the rank and file soldiers, not the officers
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An observer notes how a private soldier carries himself on parade.
explanation.definitionFit: Mien is a person's bearing or manner, the look they present.

clue.text: Top people travel it

parts.note: wealthy travellers buy the best class of rail or air ticket, the highest grade

explanation.definitionFit: First is the top position and also first class, the travel grade chosen by the elite.

clue.text: Gunners return to Southern Europe prepared for battle

indicators.note: return means the word for gunners goes back, read in reverse

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British army gunners
the Med, the Mediterranean region, is southern Europe

explanation.surface: Artillerymen head back to the Mediterranean ready to fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Armed means carrying weapons, equipped to fight.

clue.text: Strippers' code involved comradeship

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: Exotic dancers share a strict code of conduct that binds them together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' rearranges the letters of STRIPPERS and CODE.
explanation.definitionFit: Esprit de corps is French for group spirit, the loyalty and fellowship within a team.

clue.text: Basque separatist movement implicated in small fire

indicators.note: implicated in means caught up within, so the movement goes inside

parts.note: slight means small
ETA was the armed Basque separatist group in Spain

explanation.surface: Basque militants are suspected of a minor arson attack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fire' reads as a noun, a blaze, but it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To set alight is to make something burn, to ignite it.

clue.text: Cessation of hostilities on the announcement of Prince Charles' betrothal

definitions.meaning: a pulling back of fighting forces from contact with each other

definitions.text: the announcement of Prince Charles' betrothal
definitions.meaning: news that Lady Diana Spencer was to marry Charles

explanation.definitionFit: Disengagement is withdrawal from combat; split as DI'S ENGAGEMENT it is Diana's betrothal to Charles in 1981.

clue.text: Refuse an offer of Christmas goods?

definitions.meaning: read as ..., a range of stock for December

explanation.definitionFit: Decline is to refuse; split as DEC LINE it is a December range of goods.

clue.text: High spirits causing kinsman to lose his head

indicators.note: losing his head drops the first letter of the word for a kinsman

parts.note: a relation is a relative, a kinsman

explanation.surface: A relative becomes so excited he loses control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to lose his head' removes R from the front of RELATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Elation is great joy, a state of very high spirits.

clue.text: Stone and heavy metal

definitions.meaning: a lump of stone, a boulder
heavy metal is a loud style of popular music, a kind of guitar-led music

explanation.definitionFit: Rock is both a mass of stone and a genre of loud guitar music of which heavy metal is a type.

clue.text: Loot acquired by the gun

explanation.definitionFit: To rifle is to ransack and steal, and a rifle is a long gun.

clue.text: Reduce to shreds at 32 feet per second per second

parts.note: g is the symbol for the acceleration due to gravity, about 32 feet per second per second
read with the figure that follows, at stands for the rate at which something accelerates

explanation.surface: Something is torn apart as it falls under gravity.
explanation.walkthrough: 32 ft/s² is the acceleration of free fall, written g; moving 'at' it is going at the g rate.
explanation.definitionFit: To grate cheese or carrot is to rub it into small shreds.

clue.text: Henry left student accommodation

parts.note: Hal is a familiar form of the name Henry, as with Shakespeare's Prince Hal

explanation.surface: A young man called Henry has moved out of his university lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: A hall of residence is a university building where students live.

clue.text: Fish served in a Berlin grillroom

indicators.note: served in suggests the letters are held inside the phrase, as a dish

explanation.surface: A fish dish offered at a German restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: Ling is a long cod-like sea fish.

clue.text: Intimate greeting, and not without heart

parts.note: hi is an informal greeting

indicators.note: without heart drops the middle letter of not

explanation.surface: A whispered hello from someone cold-hearted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intimate' is the verb (to imply), not the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: To intimate is to suggest indirectly, to drop a clue.

clue.text: Priest is a Scotsman resident in Holland

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, title of a priest
Ian is the Scottish form of John, a typical Scotsman's name

explanation.surface: A Scottish clergyman has settled in the Netherlands.
explanation.definitionFit: A Frisian comes from Friesland, a province in the north of the Netherlands.

clue.text: A sovereign, sickly and pale

parts.note: R stands for Rex or Regina, the Latin for king or queen
ailing means unwell, sickly

explanation.surface: A king looks unwell and wan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pale' looks like a description of the sick king, but it is the noun: a fence post.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale is a fence stake or fence, and railing is a fence of rails.

clue.text: How committed environmentalists are flourishing

explanation.definitionFit: Evergreen describes plants keeping leaves all year, so lasting and thriving; split, it says committed Greens are always green.

clue.text: A conviction that can be retracted

indicators.note: retracted here means drawn back, read in reverse, and the word reads the same

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A guilty verdict that might be withdrawn on appeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retracted' hints at a court quashing a conviction; the word simply reads identically both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or belief that someone firmly holds.
